# incusos_system_kernel (Resource)

Manages IncusOS kernel-level configuration (`/1.0/system/kernel`), including sysctls, PCI passthrough/SR-IOV, ZFS ARC, hugepages, and console settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `blacklist_modules` (List of String) Kernel modules to blacklist.
- `console` (Attributes List) Serial/console devices configured for kernel output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--console))
- `cpu` (Attributes) CPU-specific kernel configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu))
- `memory` (Attributes) Memory-specific kernel configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--memory))
- `network` (Attributes) Network-specific kernel tuning parameters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network))
- `pci` (Attributes) PCI passthrough and SR-IOV configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pci))
- `zfs` (Attributes) ZFS kernel module configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zfs))

### Read-Only

- `clock_source` (String) Current kernel timekeeping clock source.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
